feature: Social R2 PR 5: card details' Wishlist section (boards R3 D1, D2, DP1, DP2)
note: Needs SOCIAL_WISHLIST_ENABLED=true on the server and a signed-in account that owns cards. The second row presses Add to wishlist, so it WRITES a wishlist row for the audit account: run it on a scratch branch off local-dev only. Each row opens the first card of /collection. The section's sibling order inside a deck (after the receipt, before the deck's own box) and D3 (from a deck's Shopping view, drawn at desktop only) are held by card-detail-wishlist.test.tsx: the section is the same box wherever the card was opened. The phone sheet opens at half height with the details column hidden: the phone rows press All details first, the desktop rows have no such control. The on-list rows write a wishlist row for the account's first card, so a second run (or the other width's) finds the card already listed: clear the account's wishlist_items between width runs.
